author: libsoftiktok
text:
Jaquoya Wix, 34, a young mother, was just randomly stabbed to death by Devon Jason Watson outside a Chipotle in Detroit where she worked

Watson was known to police and was supposed to be a following a mental health treatment plan for another incident just 2 months ago. He was released just weeks ago

Where’s the outrage?
